row.notes: In Sess_VirtualSession_EstimateLapTime: vmovaps xmm0,xmm6 at the shared epilogue (the jns 0x142f6cba8 at 0x142f6c9e4 for a session whose rules entry skips the estimate lands here). xmm6 holds the incoming lap time (param xmm3) and is only rewritten at 0x142f6cba4, so returning from here hands back the caller's own lap time. rsp is unchanged since the prologue (no push after sub rsp,0x88), the xmm6-9 and gprs are restored from the stack. Rip target of core's estimate lap time guard; never hooked. Needs L2 promotion by the session owner.
